svg.title: Hair, a rounded coil worn close, full at the crown and full behind, ramp hair-grey. Three-quarter view: the mass sits BEHIND the face plane and reaches lower at the back than at the front, and the fringe sweeps forward to clear the brow line - hair draws over the head and under the face, and a symmetric cap reads as a front view whatever the head under it is doing. Shape and colour are independent slots: every shape is offered with every colour and with every skin tone.
